name: obsidian-vault-doctor
description: Obsidian vault diagnosis and restructure expert: read-only health check, broken-link/orphan/duplicate detection, prioritized A/B/C action plan, safe file moves with automatic link rewriting and one-command rollback. Runs entirely on the user's machine with zero dependencies.

displayDescription.zh: 体检你的 Obsidian 笔记库，分清真问题与正常现象，给出健康分和分级整理清单，每步可回滚。
displayDescription.en: Health-check your Obsidian vault, tell real issues from noise, and give a graded plan with one-command rollback.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我体检这个 Obsidian 笔记库，告诉我先修什么
defaultInitPrompt.en: Check my Obsidian vault and tell me what to fix first

quickPrompts.en: Check my Obsidian vault and tell me what to fix first
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我体检这个 Obsidian 笔记库，告诉我先修什么

quickPrompts.en: My vault has grown to hundreds of notes and I can't find anything. Where do I start?
quickPrompts.zh: 我的笔记库几百篇了，找不到东西，该从哪下手

quickPrompts.en: Reorganize a folder and update all wikilinks automatically, with a way to undo
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我整理一个目录并自动更新全库链接，要能反悔
